Annual average euro exchange rates

Source: R/data.R
exchange_rates.Rd

Annual averages of the euro exchange rate (units of national currency per euro) for the non-euro countries in country_patches$non_euro: Canada (CAD), Denmark (DKK), Croatia (HRK), Hungary (HUF) and Romania (RON). build_accounts_indicators() converts turnover to national currency with them before computing turnover growth, so that growth rates are not moved by the exchange rate. Without a rate for a year, the turnover growth of that year is missing; check_inputs() reports such years.

Usage

exchange_rates

Format

A data frame with one row per currency and year:

currency

3-letter currency code (e.g. "HUF").

year

Calendar year.

rate

Annual average, units of national currency per euro.

country

2-letter country code, joined with year to the data.

Source

Eurostat, ert_bil_eur_a, https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/ERT_BIL_EUR_A/default/table?lang=en; ECB, https://data.ecb.europa.eu/data/datasets/EXR. Built by data-raw/prepare-reference-data.R.

Details

Version. Package version 0.2.0.9000 covers 2008-2025:

  • CAD, DKK, HUF, RON: Eurostat ert_bil_eur_a, as extracted from the update of 8 July 2026;

  • HRK: Croatia adopted the euro on 1 January 2023, and Eurostat no longer publishes the kuna series. 2008-2022: the ECB annual averages (series EXR.A.HRK.EUR.SP00.A, the source of the Eurostat series), rounded to 4 decimals; from 2023: the fixed conversion rate 7.53450, so that turnover growth over windows ending in 2023 or later equals growth in euros.

Version 0.1.0 shipped the rates of the earlier routines, 2008-2022 (the same Eurostat values for CAD, DKK, HUF and RON; for HRK values within 0.02 % of the ECB averages). See vignette("input-data") for the versions by package version.

An exchange_rates.dta in the input folder replaces this table in run_scaleup_pipeline() and run_trade_pipeline().
